description: This file contains Pydantic models defining schemas for request and response bodies related to authentication, connectors, LLM proxy, and registry management within a backend service.

classes.name: TenantContext
classes.description: Represents the tenant context for operations.

classes.name: ProviderAuthMethod
classes.description: Enum-like for provider auth method values.

classes.name: APIKeyAuthRequest
classes.description: Request schema for API key authentication, extending tenant context.

classes.name: APIKeyAuthResponse
classes.description: Response schema for API key authentication results.

classes.name: OAuthInitRequest
classes.description: Request schema for initiating OAuth flow.

classes.name: OAuthInitResponse
classes.description: Response schema containing OAuth authorization URL and state.

classes.name: OAuthCallbackRequest
classes.description: Request schema for OAuth callback containing authorization code.

classes.name: OAuthCallbackResponse
classes.description: Response schema for OAuth callback containing result and token info.

classes.name: ConnectorCreateRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new connector, extending tenant context.

classes.name: ConnectorResponse
classes.description: Schema representing a connector's details and status.

classes.name: LLMToolInvocation
classes.description: Schema for invoking a tool via LLM proxy.

classes.name: LLMToolResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response from an LLM tool invocation.

classes.name: RegistryUpsertRequest
classes.description: Schema for upserting registry connector info.
